'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Chris Westergaard LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergaard]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Feel The Conflict]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
